summary: Exactly ONE first-party marketing tag is present on this page: Google Tag Manager container GTM-W32M4C6F, carried by the GHL funnel-level globalHeadTrackingCode / globalBodyTrackingCode. Of those two, only the body noscript iframe is server-rendered in the HTML; the head gtm.js loader is a payload string injected client-side at hydration — see containers[0].injectedVia. There is NO directly-embedded GA4 measurement ID, NO Google Ads conversion ID, NO Facebook/Meta pixel ID, and NO CallRail script on the page. Anything beyond GTM is fired from inside the GTM container, which is not visible in the served HTML.

containers.injectedVia: SPLIT — read this before rebuilding. Only the body <noscript><iframe> is server-rendered as parsed markup. The head gtm.js loader is NOT in <head> in the served HTML: it exists solely as an escaped string under the GHL funnel key globalHeadTrackingCode inside the __NUXT_DATA__ payload, and is written into the document client-side by the Nuxt bundle at hydration. A rebuild that drops the Nuxt bundle keeps the noscript iframe and silently loses GTM itself.
